astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Western Moon, Eastern Sea
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: The Mare Orientale, Latin for Eastern Sea, is one of the most striking large scale lunar features. The youngest of the large lunar impact basins it's very difficult to see from an earthbound perspective.
